page.layout: One page of text, one column, with no margin notes. Running head at the top; page number at the top left; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: cem contra fuos æmulos prædicari iussit, imperatorem à Pontifice deponi posse sanciuit, & octauas Mariæ natiuitatis celebrari mandauit. Et ut de locustis Apocalypticis aliquid dicam: Mendicantium ordinum fratres (inquit Stella) plurimum dilexit, & eos quidem Apostolicis sauoribus & priuilegijs, ac multis beneficijs, quoad uixit, profequi non desitit. Dominicanos ad prælaturas promouit, ut patet de Hugone Cardinale, Ioanne Bofnensi præsule, & Guilhelmo Anteradensi episcopo. Franciscanos ad suam confessionem uocabat: erat enim ei Nicolaus Anglicus ab animæ secretis. Carmelitas & Augustinianos in adoptionis filios admisit, & ex professis Christianis per nouam for-mationem suas creaturas fecit. Ab eremi[?] adur-bes pertraxit, & in ocio suum mendicare panem docuit. Carmelitarum regulam, ab Alberto Hie-rosolymorum patriarcha prius eis traditam, per Dominicanos correxit, mitigauit, declarauit, at-tum demum cum Apostatica benedictione confirmauit, ut non de solo Saluatore (ut eadem dicat regula) salutem sperarent. Permisit eos cum ceteris Mendicantium ordinibus, diuinum Dei uerbum adulterantes, prædicare, ut Abadonis regnum to[?] citius promoueretur: disputare, & eius aduersarij per Aristotelem confunderentur: & confessiones audi

page.notes: Running head and page number read clearly. The line-end at "per nouam for-" and the next line's "mationem" were read as one word split at the line end; the hyphen is inferred. "Ab eremi[?] adur-" and the following "bes" are doubtful: the join is unclear in the scan. "regnum to[?]" is uncertain. The catchword "audi" is printed at the lower right, and the text is cut off there. A faint show-through of the reverse page is visible at the right edge and was left out.
